note: Address Inspector (inspect>) gets a close X (top-right of the results panel, 36x36, aria-label 'cerrar') on every panel state: loading, result and error. Closing clears the panel and the inspection state (balance, UTXO list, current page, tip), empties the inspect> field and focuses it; an RPC answer that arrives after closing, or for an older inspect, is dropped instead of re-opening stale data. INSPECT with an empty field takes the same close path. search>, reconciliation and UTXO pagination logic unchanged.
